name: gemini-media-mcp
description: Generate images (Nano Banana), video (Veo, Gemini Omni), speech (Gemini TTS) and music (Lyria) with Google's generative media models.
long_description:
Create and edit images with Nano Banana, generate, edit and extend Veo and Gemini Omni video clips with native audio, turn text into single- or two-voice speech, and compose music with Lyria. Every call reports its estimated cost, `estimate_cost` compares options before you spend, and optional budgets stop runaway spend. Files are saved to your output directory.

Use a Gemini API key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey, or a Vertex AI project with gcloud application-default credentials.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Create images from a prompt, optionally guided by reference images

tools.name: edit_image
tools.description: Change an existing image with an instruction while keeping the rest

tools.name: tile_image
tools.description: Cut an image into overlapping crops for upscaling past 4K (free, local)

tools.name: stitch_tiles
tools.description: Align and blend edited tiles into one large PNG, 8K by default (free, local)

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start a Veo or Gemini Omni video clip with native audio (asynchronous)

tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Check or wait for a video job and download the finished clip

tools.name: extend_video
tools.description: Continue a completed clip (Omni up to 40 s, Veo about 7 s per call)

tools.name: edit_video
tools.description: Change an existing clip with an instruction (Gemini Omni)

tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Turn text into speech with one voice or a two-speaker dialogue

tools.name: generate_music
tools.description: Compose music clips or full songs with Lyria

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List current models, aliases, capabilities and prices

tools.name: estimate_cost
tools.description: Estimate the cost of a request before running it

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Report estimated spend and budget remaining

tools.name: get_config
tools.description: Show the active backend, output directory, defaults and warnings

gemini_api_key.title: Gemini API key
gemini_api_key.description: Key from https://aistudio.google.com/apikey. Leave empty to use Vertex AI or the key saved by `gemini-media-mcp configure`.

google_cloud_project.title: Google Cloud project (Vertex AI)
google_cloud_project.description: Optional. Use Vertex AI in this project with gcloud application-default credentials instead of an API key.

google_cloud_location.title: Google Cloud location (Vertex AI)
google_cloud_location.description: Optional Vertex AI region. Empty means global.

output_dir.title: Output directory
output_dir.description: Where generated media is saved. Empty means ~/generated_media.
